abstract: A case of mixed gonadal dysgenesis with anaplastic seminoma is herein reported. A 38-years-old man was admitted to our hospital with the chief complaint of a painful mass, 19.0 cm in long diameter in his lower abdomen. At 11, 13 and 14 years old he had the history of treatment for an ambiguous external genitalia and defect of both scrotal contents. In the concrete, laparotomy, chordectomy and urethroplasty were performed at those times and the laparotomy revealed a right immature abdominal testis and Müllerian structures. Laboratory examination revealed elevated levels of serum lactic dehydrogenase and HCG. The karyotype from the cultured lymphocyte was that of a normal male. Because the histological finding of biopsied abdominal tumor was shown to be an anaplastic seminoma, firstly two courses of chemotherapy using cisplatin vinblastine and bleomycin were induced, and that after an extensive resection for the tumor and Müllerian structure including some portions of surrounding tissue was performed. We reviewed 40 cases of mixed gonadal dysgenesis reported previously in the Japanese literature and 8 cases of that with a gonadal tumor.
abstract_ja: 未分化セミノーマを伴う混合性性腺異形成の症例を報告する。38歳の男性が、下腹部に長径19.0 cmの有痛性腫瘤を主訴に当院を受診した。11、13、14歳時に、外性器の性別不明と両側陰嚢内容の欠損に対する治療歴があった。具体的には、その都度開腹術、索切除術、尿道形成術が行われ、開腹時に右側の未熟な腹腔内精巣とミュラー管構造が認められた。検査では血清乳酸脱水素酵素とhCGの上昇が認められた。培養リンパ球の核型は正常男性型であった。腹部腫瘍の生検組織学的所見は未分化セミノーマであったため、まずシスプラチン、ビンブラスチン、ブレオマイシンによる化学療法を2コース施行し、その後、腫瘍およびミュラー管構造を周囲組織の一部も含めて広範に切除した。以前に日本の文献で報告された混合性性腺異形成40例と、性腺腫瘍を伴う8例を検討した。
